quote: WHY: no PRESSED line, no RETRACTED line, and no statement that names a pressing round and quotes it, for D2 vs C3
why: The rule governs when a verse counts as an unanswered witness — requiring the pressing round to be named and its sentence quoted — and the judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness but instead flags exactly this missing quoting/naming, so it does not violate the rule.
